BiblicalUsage: A bezel is the setting that holds a jewel, and the one place this word appears is in the covering of the king of Tyre, where the workmanship of his settings is named among the precious stones. The stone is the glory; the bezel is the craft that holds it where it can be seen.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the setting is part of the beauty — God does not only make the jewel, He makes the place that shows it.
